boundaryGate.question: 在任何 P1 代码改动前，能否在真实 BiliDili workspace 上捕获 live HEAD 的六链 PRE characterization baseline，并证明只触碰 BiliDili workspace 且 DeepSeek/Qwen 配置未错配？
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: 真实 BiliDili workspace 及其对应 ~/.asd workspace DB/envelope/log 证据；不得修改产品代码、不得触碰非 BiliDili workspace、不得把 thread id 写入 tracked docs。
controllerSelfChecks: Controller claimed state root .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-lifecycle-naming-layering-refactor-2026-06-26 at revision 2.
Requirement authority read: original plan + requirement design §A/§12; G1 PRE baseline must run before P1.
Wakeflow status/repo facts show live heads match §12.0 intent: Alembic 47889f9, AlembicCore 934d043, AlembicPlugin 9931596, AlembicAgent 99b8b33.
realverify state root is already archived/completed; its true coverage verification is folded into this demand G4, not this G1 baseline.
realScenarioConditions: Use the real BiliDili checkout/workspace, not a sandbox clone.
Use the real ALEMBIC_HOME, but confine operations to the BiliDili workspace record/DB only.
Use DeepSeek for in-process author generation and local Qwen for embeddings/vector work; do not swap providers.
If rebuild/reset is needed, only rebuild/delete recipes for BiliDili as authorized by the requirement.
successMeans: Evidence names the exact BiliDili root, DB path, live heads, Node version, provider mapping, and commands run.
A baseline JSON/report records coverage_ledger, deep_mining_rounds, knowledge_entries, recipe_source_refs, evolution_proposals, git_diff_checkpoints counts and relevant non-empty/round max fields.
Evidence states which of the six chain baselines were captured, with envelope/log/DB refs or a precise safe blocker per chain.
Evidence proves no non-BiliDili workspace was modified beyond authorized BiliDili recipe rebuild/reset.
failureMeans: BiliDili root or DB cannot be uniquely identified.
Provider mapping cannot be proven or is wrong.
A needed command would affect non-BiliDili workspace state.
Baseline run fails before producing reviewable DB/log evidence.
cannotConclude: Cannot conclude P1-P15 are implemented or accepted.
Cannot conclude post-refactor parity is green.
Cannot conclude G4 coverage gate passed after refactor.
Cannot conclude realverify is fully verified beyond the baseline evidence captured here.
stopConditions: Stop before destructive action if BiliDili root/DB mapping is uncertain.
Stop if a command would touch any non-BiliDili workspace.
Stop if DeepSeek/Qwen configuration appears mismatched.
Stop if credentials/secrets would need to be exposed in evidence.
Stop if real BiliDili checkout is dirty in a way that would make baseline attribution unreliable.

evidenceRequired: BiliDili root and DB path proof.
Command transcript or summarized command outputs.
Workspace-touch audit showing only BiliDili affected.
allowedOperations: Locate and prove the BiliDili project root and its matching workspace DB path.
Capture git heads for Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicPlugin, AlembicAgent, and BiliDili before running baseline.
Run the §12.3.0 PRE baseline SQL/count snapshot against BiliDili DB.
Capture available baseline envelopes/logs for the six chains or, if a chain cannot be safely driven at G1, record the precise blocker and the pre-run state needed later.
Run read-only/provider configuration checks sufficient to prove DeepSeek/Qwen mapping before any generated run.
Write evidence under the state-root target-results/evidence area or Test-owned temp evidence path and return refs.
forbiddenOperations: Do not edit product source code.
Do not push, tag, release, bump versions, or alter vendor gitlinks.
Do not reset/delete any non-BiliDili workspace or global ~/.asd records.
Do not run destructive cleanup until the BiliDili root/DB mapping is proven.
Do not treat the baseline as P1-P15 acceptance, G4 coverage pass, or post-refactor parity.
